name: football-stories
description: Narrated football story Shorts with no footage: find and verify story ideas with two sources per fact (evidence legwork on a cheaper Sonnet subagent, judgement on the session model), draft a fact-cited script, narrate it with a free or paid voice (Gemini TTS free tier, local Kokoro, your own recording) at a slightly slower pace, align the words with Whisper, build animated cards from a template library with word-timed captions, and revise from numbered feedback.
